newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Sept retail sales down, wholesale sales up.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Sept retail sales down, wholesale sales up.

text.p: Mexico's retail sales were down 1.8 percent in September versus the same month a year ago, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said Friday.
INEGI said September wholesale sales rose 3.1 percent compared to the same month in 1995.
The wholesale figures were in line with expectations. A Reuters survey of 11 brokerages, banks and research firms forecast a 3.13 percent increase in wholesale sales.
But the retail figures were totally unexpected. A Reuters survey estimated retail sales would rise 0.99 percent in the month compared to the same month a year earlier.
INEGI reported that wholesale sales increased in 17 cities, compared to 18 in August.
Purchases by wholesalers, INEGI said, grew 10.9 percent in September against the same month a year earlier. Purchases by retailers fell by 1.6 percent in September compared to the same month in 1995.
